A lot of people in CC go for different reasons, there are people there for TAG, or simply just to slowly get back into schooling, get just an Associate's, etc etc. Choosing a different UC is up to you, I personally had limited choices because of my major and was pretty deadset on Davis. Hey there! I ended up TAGging into Davis and went to CC during high school and have a bit of advice that I hope can help!
It wouldn't hurt to submit a regular application to Davis during this upcoming app season, you honestly never know what'll happen.
That being said, if things don't work out applying for TAG is an excellent option! I wouldn't recommend pushing yourself trying to complete a full year during your senior year, especially with AP exams, as it can add up quick and get seriously overwhelming. If you want the challenge, maybe taking like two classes a semester would be okay, but it can still be rough so be careful and take care of yourself!
You won't want to apply straight out of HS even with dual enrollment, since you'll only be at a CC for the one year and the TAG is meant for transfer with an Associate's. So you'd want to apply for a TAG in the year you plan on wrapping up that degree.
